body: Apollo Global Inc. APO is finalizing a deal to buy a 10% stake in Mubadala CapitalThe announcement is expected on Monday, according to a report from CNBC's Scott Wapner. Apollo has been working in Abu Dhabi for 15 years. Apollo already has a large partnership with Mubadala Capital's parent. Terms of the deal weren't known.Mubadala Capital advises and administers over $755 billion.Mubadala and Apollo declined to comment to CNBC.Developing story ...DisclaimerContent provided by Seeking Alpha is intended for information purposes only, and that Seeking Alpha does not offer any personalist investment advice and is not a licensed securities dealer, broker, US investment adviser or investment bank.
